# Was the Starbucks Mobile Order & Pay outage a cyberattack?

**Not established.** Not established. Starbucks said only that there was 'an issue' and gave no cause. No source reports an attack or a claim of one, but nothing has ruled one out.

Incident: Starbucks Mobile Order & Pay outage, Nov 20, 2026. Also reported as the Starbucks app outage and Starbucks app down. First published Nov 20, 2026; last updated Nov 20, 2026, 7:49 PM ET.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. Starbucks Mobile Order & Pay is used across the US. The tracker's reports peaked at about 58 times normal for roughly five hours. Starbucks has not said how many customers or orders were affected.
- Who is affected: US customers who order or pay in the Starbucks app. Stores and drive-thrus stayed open. If you were charged for an order that never arrived, check your app history and ask Starbucks support.

### Known so far

- Customers in the US saw errors, zero balances and failed payments in the Starbucks app on Friday, Nov 20.

### Not known yet

- What caused the problem. Starbucks has said only that there was an issue.
- Whether it was a cyberattack. No source reports one, and nothing has ruled one out.
- How many customers and orders were affected.
- Whether customers were charged for orders that failed, and how refunds will work.
- Whether Starbucks says service is fully restored.
